AI coding memory, Claude Code history, Cursor history, local codin"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"g agent memory, MCP memory server & Claude compaction."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Your coding agents stop re-debugging what you already fixed."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Hermes and 36 more agents already save e"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"very session to disk."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"deja indexes all of it locally and hands the relevant history back over MCP and hooks — no LLM, one "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"es all of it locally and hands the relevant history back over MCP and hooks — no LLM, one Go binary."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Español | Português | Français | Deutsch | Русский | Türkçe | हि"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ish | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Español | Português | Français | Deutsch | Русский | Türkçe | हिन्दी"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Website & interactive search · Live browser demo · Docs · Benchmarks · How it compares · Building it"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"active search · Live browser demo · Docs · Benchmarks · How it compares · Building it into your tool"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Or with Homebrew: brew install deja-vu && deja install --auto · Claude Code plugin: claude plugin ma"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"rketplace add vshulcz/deja-vu && claude plugin install deja-vu@deja-vu · Agent Skills: npx skills ad"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"d vshulcz/deja-vu
Windows (Scoop / winget), Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and more · Try without install"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ing: npx @vshulcz/deja-vu sources · Live demo →"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Recall

the next of seven tools takes 72 s"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Every driver, corpus and scoring rule is in this repository: head-to-head · all benchmark runs"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Search it yourself"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`deja` with no arguments opens a terminal search across every agent's history — starting with
the se"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ssions behind your uncommitted changes, then recent work in the current project."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Navigate:** `↑↓` picks a session, `↵` opens at the match, `/` searches inside a session, `]` `[`"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" jump between turns, `^s` toggles date/relevance sort (`deja search --sort date`).
- **Filter:** by "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"agent (`codex:`), time (`today`, `yesterday`, `week`, `month`), or project (`in:<project>`).
- **Res"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ume or hand off:** `r` reopens the session in its native agent; `o` continues it in another agent wi"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"th its goal, decisions and open work.
- **Recover deleted chats:** `tab` switches between this proje"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ct, all projects, and **Deleted** (sessions an agent purged that deja still holds); `R` restores one"},{"id":"p13s7","text":", `D` deletes (`deja delete <id>`), `?` lists all keys."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Prefer a browser? `deja view` exports the store — sessions, the recall audit trail, and promoted not"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"es — into one local HTML file (try the live demo). With `DEJA_TUI=0` (or `deja brief`), `deja` print"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"s a plain-text summary."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Starts full on day one.** Months of existing transcripts across all forty-three agents are searc"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"hable immediately — fix a bug in Codex and Claude Code, Cursor or OpenCode recalls it.
- **Automatic"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" recall via hooks & MCP.** Surfaces prior sessions at session start, before a file edit or command r"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"uns, and when a command fails.
- **Survives compaction.** Over 43 measured compactions, summaries ke"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"pt 77% of decisions and 0.2% of commands; deja hands back the rest (how).
- **Indexes code changes, "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"not just chat.** Tracks opened files, commands with exit codes, and exact `Edit` spans (`deja blame "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"<file>:<line>`, `deja restore <path>`).
- **Tracks decision lifecycle & staleness.** `deja promote <"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"id> --state rejected` marks a reverted approach so later hits warn why it was dropped (`--state acce"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"pted` takes the mark back), and hits report when files touched by a session have changed since.
- **"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"Travels with the repository.** `deja repo add` commits the decisions and dead ends you pick into `.d"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"eja/memory.jsonl`; a teammate's agent recalls them after a clone (repo memory).
- **Local and privat"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"e by default.** Zero LLM calls, no cloud account, and automatic credential redaction at index time ("},{"id":"p16s13","text":"ult.** Zero LLM calls, no cloud account, and automatic credential redaction at index time (privacy)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Your own work, wrapped"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`deja stats --card` draws your yearly agent activity in the terminal or writes an SVG for your GitHu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"b profile (convert to PNG in browser)."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`install.sh` places the `deja` binary in `~/.local/bin`, and `deja install --auto` wires MCP recall "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"and hooks into every detected agent and builds the initial index (~10s)."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Privacy"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Indexing and search are local. The network is used only by `deja update`, `deja sync ssh`,
the versi"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"on check in `deja doctor`, `deja embed` against an endpoint you configure (and,
once it has built th"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"e semantic sidecar, each search, which sends the query to that
endpoint), and a once-a-day look at t"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"he latest release from an interactive command. That look sends no
session data; `DEJA_OFFLINE=1` tur"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ns it off, and so does `DEJA_NO_UPDATE_NOTICE` set to any
value, which also hides the note a new ver"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"sion prints on its first run."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Credentials are stripped as the index is built: cloud and provider keys, tokens and JWTs,
PEM blocks"},{"id":"p24s2","text":", passwords in URLs or stated in prose. Each becomes `[redacted:<kind>]` and the
text around it stay"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"s searchable. The source transcripts still hold them
(one machine had 84 in 42 sessions):
`deja secr"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ets` names those sessions without printing a value, and `deja secrets --scrub`
rewrites the ones it "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"can, keeping the original beside the file."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`deja forget` drops sessions and keeps them dropped across rebuilds. `~/.config/deja/exclude`
skips "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"a project per line, or a whole store with `harness:opencode`. The
security model has the data flows "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"and what redaction cannot catch."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Local inverted index in `~/.cache/deja`: parse the JSONL and SQLite stores, redact
credentials, writ"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"e an append-only `records.bin` plus token buckets, and track per-file state in
`manifest.gob` so rep"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"eat runs only ingest what changed. The MCP server, stats, share and
sync all read that one index. De"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"tails in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md."}],"truncated":true}
